temperature, different time: thickness decides how long the heat takes to reach the middle. Size Air fryer Oven 6-inch round pan 325°F / 165°C · 18 min 350°F / 175°C · 21 min 7-inch square pan 325°F / 165°C · 22 min 350°F / 175°C · 26 min Deep or extra-fudgy batch 325°F / 165°C · 26 min 350°F / 175°C · 31 min Why the edges overbake while the middle stays wet Brownie batter is dense and heavy, and in a metal pan the edges sit in the strongest heat, against the hot sides and right under the fan. They set and dry long before the centre, which is insulated by batter on every side. Turn the heat up to rush the middle and you get a hard rim and a crust that cracks away from a wet core. The lower setting gives heat time to reach the centre. Pan size matters just as much: a 5 qt basket is about 8 to 8½ inches across, so a 6- or 7-inch pan fits with room for air to move around it. A standard 9×9-inch recipe has to be halved or baked in two rounds; poured deeper into a small pan, it will not set in the middle. Worked example: half a 9×9 recipe A 9×9-inch brownie recipe that says 350°F for 26 minutes, halved and poured into a lined 7-inch square pan. Preheat 3 minutes and bake at 325°F for 22 minutes. A 6-inch round pan takes about 18 minutes, and a deeper or extra-fudgy batch about 26. Leave it to cool in the pan before cutting. How to tell they are done A toothpick pushed into the centre should come out with moist crumbs, not liquid batter. The top should look dry and slightly cracked at the edges, with only a faint wobble in the middle. Brownies keep cooking in the hot pan, so take them out a little early. Cut them only once they are fully cool, for clean squares. Before they go in Line the pan with parchment, leaving two edges long so you can lift the brownies out. Check the pan sits flat with a gap all round. If the top darkens early, cover it loosely with foil, tucked under the pan so it cannot blow off. About 22 minutes at 325°F in a 7-inch square pan. A 6-inch round pan takes around 18 minutes and a deeper batch around 26. What size pan fits a 5 qt air fryer? A 6- or 7-inch round or square pan. The basket is about 8 to 8½ inches across, and air needs room around the pan. Can I bake a 9×9 brownie recipe in the air fryer? Halve it, or bake it in two rounds. Poured into one small pan, it is too deep to set in the middle. Can I use a boxed brownie mix? Yes. Most boxes make a 9×9 or 8×8 pan, so use half the batter per round and follow the times here. What is the oven equivalent? 350°F for around 26 minutes for the same pan in a conventional oven.
